一个连接，使用多家模型: Multiple model providers in one connection
自定义连接 · 兼容接口或本地服务: Custom connection · Compatible or local API
选择你要使用的服务，下一步填写 API 密钥。: Choose a service, then enter its API key.
可以通过下方的“其他服务”填写连接地址。: Use Other services below to enter a custom endpoint.
默认使用国内站 API；其他区域可在自定义设置中修改地址。: Uses the China API by default. Change the endpoint under Custom settings for other regions.
默认使用北京地域的按量 API；其他地域或套餐请按接入文档修改地址。: Uses the pay-as-you-go API in Beijing by default. See the setup guide for other regions or plans.
默认使用国内站的按量 API；Coding Plan 请按接入文档修改地址。: Uses the China pay-as-you-go API by default. See the setup guide for the Coding Plan endpoint.
新会话默认使用，会话中可随时切换。: Used for new conversations. Switch at any time.
留空自动识别名称。: Leave blank to use the detected name.
未识别的能力暂不开启。服务未提供信息时，可根据其说明手动设置。: Unknown capabilities stay off. Use the provider’s documentation to configure them manually.
留空自动使用不超过 8K 的输出预算。: Leave blank for an automatic output budget up to 8K.
留空使用服务默认值。: Leave blank to use the provider default.
自动识别名称、图片、思考和长度规格；未识别的项目可在添加后核对。: Names, image input, reasoning and token limits are detected automatically. Review unknown capabilities after adding.
选择要使用的模型，能力信息将一并保存。: Select models to use. Their detected capabilities will be saved too.
识别结果已过期，请重新获取模型信息。: Detection results have expired. Fetch model information again.
连接已变更，请重新获取模型信息。: The connection has changed. Fetch model information again.
密钥已变更，请重新获取模型信息。: The key has changed. Fetch model information again.
目录之外的模型需要配置 API 类型和地址。: Models outside the catalog require an API protocol and base URL.
